purpose: Teach: コミットメント/印刷物/公職/増産/ふさわしく/簡略/お買い得/取り直し

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察への、本気で、絶対、コミットメント、絶対、企業様、絶対、明確に、絶対、お願いいたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're asking for your company's genuine commitment to supporting the police — it's a serious matter, and we're truly grateful.
lines.style: Measured, official opening. Clear diction on key words. Respectful but not deferential. Even pace, steady eye contact. The tone of someone trained to be understood.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察様の、本気で、絶対、印刷物、絶対、社内、絶対、掲示、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Of course. We've posted the materials you provided throughout our offices — thank you for trusting us with this.
lines.style: Responsive, professional. Slight lean forward on affirmation. Warm under the formality. Not rushing, but efficient. The voice of someone honoring a request.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 公職、本気で、絶対、選挙、絶対、警備、絶対、警察、絶対、対応、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're coordinating security measures for the election with our department — your cooperation makes all the difference.
lines.style: Professional update. Slight emphasis on 「進めております」 — conveying active progress. Composed, authoritative without coldness. The steady voice of procedural competence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。防犯機器の、本気で、絶対、増産、絶対、警察様の、絶対、ご依頼で、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're ramping up production on the security equipment at your request — we appreciate the partnership.
lines.style: Engaged, businesslike. Small nod of acknowledgment on opening. Clear, direct delivery. Pride in the action being taken. Steady rhythm matching the professionalism of the exchange.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察の制服に、本気で、絶対、ふさわしく、絶対、装い、絶対、整えております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Our officers are equipped and presented appropriately — everything is in order.
lines.style: Formal confirmation. Slight weight on 「ふさわしく」 — conveying readiness and standards. Measured cadence. No room for doubt. The assurance of someone accountable for details.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。手続き、本気で、絶対、簡略、絶対、化、絶対、警察様、絶対、ご相談、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've consulted with you on streamlining procedures — it makes everything easier for everyone.
lines.style: Cooperative affirmation. Slight uplift on 「簡略化」 — showing we've listened and acted. Warm professionalism. The tone of someone pleased to have found solutions together.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察用品の、本気で、絶対、お買い得、絶対、購入ルート、絶対、ご紹介、絶対、いただきました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: You've connected us with reliable, cost-effective suppliers — that support is invaluable.
lines.style: Genuine gratitude breaking through formality. Slight warmth on 「いただきました」. Still composed, but there's real appreciation in the delivery. The voice of someone acknowledging genuine help.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警備計画の、本気で、絶対、取り直し、絶対、対応、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're working on revising the security plan with your input — we want to get this right.
lines.style: Closing affirmation. Earnest, slightly forward-leaning. Light emphasis on 「進めております」. The voice of someone committed to follow-through. Respectful, but genuine beneath the formality.
